design.complete_case_rule: an event-seed enters that event's primary analysis only when both arms x every repeat child is identity-valid, health-accepted, and has a finite primary outcome; the cross-event aggregate uses the intersection complete across all three events
design.primary_realism_criterion: the equal-weight balanced complete-case mean 25-point normalized-log trajectory for social_on must match the preregistered crash/full-recovery/positive-jump target for every event and the preregistered cross-event depth order; realism drop is min(exp(mean_log_path))-1
design.primary_social_estimand: paired event-seed mean-K drop_depth(social_on)-mean-K drop_depth(social_off), plus an equally weighted cross-event mean over seeds complete in every event
design.effect_sign: positive means social_on is less negative or more positive than social_off
design.estimand: mean seed-level treatment effect, event-specific and equally weighted across the three events

reference_data_catalog.binding_policy: the selection must contain exactly this catalog input; every event_id, reference_csv, and news_timeline path must match both design.events and the unique catalog dataset before content hashes are accepted

acceptance_and_execution.workers_policy: record the effective value and hold it fixed within a study; changing it does not redefine the estimand but requires a new execution manifest
acceptance_and_execution.attempt_series_coordination: the driver holds one nonblocking advisory lock at the canonical study output root for its entire preflight, execution, selection, and summary lifecycle; every launched child inherits the lock descriptor so an orphaned in-flight child retains ownership until it terminates
acceptance_and_execution.attempt_inflight_policy: an occupied ACTIVE or running attempt is never classified as rejected and never advances the series; lock contention or an independently observed active attempt causes a safe parent stop, after which a later parent must reacquire the lock and reassess the exact attempt
acceptance_and_execution.attempt_budget_scope: one bounded five-attempt series per preregistered slot in the single canonical repository results_multi_event root; selectable alternate live output roots are prohibited and cannot reset the local cap
acceptance_and_execution.live_source_snapshot_policy: live execution requires a completely clean repository and HEAD exactly equal to the last commit that changed the canonical protocol artifact; every accepted live child must bind that same commit and scientific component fingerprint
acceptance_and_execution.launch_order_policy: multi_event_launch_order_v1: iterate repeat position then seed position; rotate canonical event order by (repeat_position+seed_position)%3; launch both arms adjacently; social_on is first exactly when (repeat_position+seed_position+canonical_event_position)%2==1; each event occupies each temporal position eight times and has 12 on-first plus 12 off-first blocks
acceptance_and_execution.scientific_runtime_environment_policy: every multi-event attempt series, child, plan, selection, and pooled study binds scientific_runtime_environment_v1: Python implementation/version, platform/architecture, and exact numpy/matplotlib/anthropic/openai/httpx versions including null; live accepted children must be uniform
acceptance_and_execution.raw_audit_artifact_policy: every accepted child must register and preserve experiment_result.json, its canonical compatibility JSON, llm_records.jsonl, events.jsonl, and private_events.jsonl; private_events.jsonl and llm_records.jsonl must be non-symlink regular files with exact mode 0600
acceptance_and_execution.parent_network_policy: the live parent truthfully records network_access=true for connectivity probes only; LLM provider calls belong to managed children; mock and dry parents record network_access=false
acceptance_and_execution.health_contract: multi_event_health_v1 requires total_llm_orders>0 and nonnegative integer counts; bad_orders is the union of strict-schema, legacy-parse, and provider-fallback final-decision failures represented by disjoint exhaustive failure_union_counts; bad_frac must equal round(bad_orders/total_llm_orders,4), while the acceptance threshold is applied to the unrounded ratio

variance_components.K_extension_rule: if reviewed and approved, add the same repeat index to every planned cell; never extend selected cells only

trajectory_envelope.policy: compute one pointwise mean path per complete seed across K, then take fixed pointwise 10th/90th percentiles across seeds; child repeats are not independent envelope units

reference_phase_transform.source_domain: every captured reference observation from t0 through the terminal observation, inclusive
reference_phase_transform.dtw_reference: report both the 25-point transformed path and the raw full post-t0 episode
reference_phase_transform.timeline_order: stable source order for equal mapped rounds
reference_phase_transform.no_curve_fit: the same event-independent transform and fixed 25-point target are committed before any grid outcome; no outcome-dependent warping, truncation, or parameter fitting is allowed

approval_record.scope: reference-derived qualitative category thresholds and ordering margin
approval_record.rationale: reference-derived, fixed before any simulation outcomes; the user authorized proceeding but did not explicitly approve the numeric values

qualitative_thresholds.finite_value_policy: every value entering a category or ordering comparison must be finite, otherwise that assessment is indeterminate and cannot pass
qualitative_thresholds.policy: the analyzer evaluates these exact inclusive thresholds without fitting them to simulation outcomes

effective_config_freeze.source: nmsim.config.Config executable defaults plus experiments.run_seed.build_population(m=0.5,total=30) and the existing run_seed seed_fraction override

news_timeline.event_bound: the exact normalized public delivery_t entries selected by event_id
news_timeline.identity_requirement: content hash and normalized entries recorded in each child scientific input identity; no analyzer-side injection

reference_path.identity_requirement: content hash recorded in each child scientific input identity

model_request.resolved_provider_and_model_policy: every accepted child records requested and resolved identities; an alias or endpoint change is reported and cannot be silently pooled

analysis_input_contract.selection: one finished experiments.multi_event parent run_manifest.json; the analyzer derives and rehashes its registered sibling multi_event_selection.json, multi_event_plan.json, multi_event_attempts.jsonl, mode-0600 multi_event_attempts.private.jsonl, driver_summary.json, and mode-0600 driver_failures.private.jsonl; arbitrary standalone selection JSON is ineligible and no directory discovery or globbing is allowed
analysis_input_contract.driver_parent_policy: the parent must be terminal and output-complete with command_identity experiments.multi_event and the frozen protocol/input identities; an openai_live parent must bind the canonical repository results_multi_event root and clean protocol-owning source snapshot; plan slots, public attempt outcomes, accepted/missing selection cells, and driver completed/failed/honest-N counts must agree exactly
analysis_input_contract.execution_plan_policy: openai_live must exactly use the frozen 144-slot counterbalanced launch plan, the one canonical repository results_multi_event root, and the clean protocol-owning source snapshot; mock may declare a non-adherent subset and driver-selected temporary root for engineering acceptance, with an override reason and no preregistered realism claim; dry-run is explicitly non-live and makes no source-snapshot or output-root eligibility claim
analysis_input_contract.attempt_ledger_policy: every accepted child has non-empty unique attempt_run_ids bounded by max_child_attempts and accepted_run_id equal to identity.run_id; rejected slots list their unique bounded attempts, missing slots list none, and one managed run_id cannot be assigned to multiple slots; the canonical-root inherited advisory lock prevents concurrent parents or orphaned active children from advancing one series, and ACTIVE attempts are never counted as rejected technical attempts
analysis_input_contract.reported_model_alias_policy: each live child binds exactly one endpoint-reported alias across application attempt evidence, selection identity, and experiment_result; an alias is accepted byte-exact only when it is 1..256 printable characters, equals its own strip result, has no leading/trailing whitespace or control characters, and may contain safe printable interior spaces; invalid aliases are rejected and never trimmed; a single study alias permits pooling only under one homogeneous self-reported endpoint condition, underlying_model_identity_verified is always false, mixed live aliases prohibit alias-homogeneous pooling, and mock records an empty list
analysis_input_contract.required_hashes: the protocol freezes the authoritative catalog/reference/timeline SHA-256 values; the finished parent registers and hashes the selection, plan, public and private attempt ledgers, driver summary, and private driver-failures artifact; the selection repeats frozen input hashes, scientific runtime environment identity, and supplies SHA-256 for each child manifest and experiment_result.json

scientific_semantics_change.simulator_change: adds opt-in Config.news_timeline delivery and public prompt observation plus opt-in multi_event_decision_response_v1 strict response validation; the empty timeline and null decision schema preserve the legacy one-shot news and coercive parser paths
scientific_semantics_change.changes_prompt_observation: true only when news_timeline is non-empty
scientific_semantics_change.analysis_change: adds a preregistered complete-case, K-repeat distributional estimator, deterministic counterbalanced launch order, strict failure-union health gate, runtime-environment identity, and managed derived-artifact boundary
scientific_semantics_change.compatibility: legacy flat results are not eligible inputs; existing analyzers and result schemas are unchanged
